name: Procgen Benchmark
description: A suite of procedurally-generated environments for measuring sample efficiency and generalization in reinforcement learning. Procgen provides 16 game-like environments with configurable training and test levels; it is an environment suite, not a static downloadable dataset.
citation: Cobbe, K., Hesse, C., Hilton, J., & Schulman, J. (2020). Leveraging Procedural Generation to Benchmark Reinforcement Learning. Proceedings of the 37th International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 119, 2048–2056. https://proceedings.mlr.press/v119/cobbe20a.html

license.notes: The upstream repository does not identify a standard SPDX license for the Procgen environments. Review the repository and any applicable asset or dependency terms before use or redistribution.
